# Core Bins, Create bin (census #50, C1): templates/bins.html rendered as router.go renders it.
# The Node field is a host bins.js mounts the shared node picker on, over PAGE_NODES (its rows
# and the hidden node_id input it adds: bins-page.txt).

Node (optional): <div id="bin-create-node"> inside the form

The form posts (a native POST /bins/create, gated by bins.js confirmBinCreate; the body is the
browser's): bin_type_id, label_prefix, quantity, status, and node_id from the picker's hidden input
On success: 303 to /bins. On a refusal: http.Error text, which the browser shows as the page
(see refusal-shapes.txt bins.create.400); no script reads it.
The node list is serialised once, as PAGE_NODES for bins.js (Create bin, Move, the label check).
